connector.name: Localstack MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: A LocalStack MCP Server providing essential tools for local cloud development & testing
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package localstack-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the localstack account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LOCALSTACK_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: LocalStack Auth Token (required for all LocalStack MCP tools)

env.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Source AWS access key used by AWS Replicator to read external AWS resources

env.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Source AWS secret access key used by AWS Replicator to read external AWS resources

env.name: AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
env.description: Optional source AWS session token used by AWS Replicator for temporary credentials

env.name: AWS_DEFAULT_REGION
env.description: Source AWS region used by AWS Replicator

env.name: AWS_REPLICATOR_SOURCE_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
env.description: Optional Replicator-specific source AWS access key. Use this instead of AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID when the Replicator source account should be isolated from generic AWS config.

env.name: AWS_REPLICATOR_SOURCE_AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
env.description: Optional Replicator-specific source AWS secret access key. Use with AWS_REPLICATOR_SOURCE_AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID.

env.name: AWS_REPLICATOR_SOURCE_AWS_SESSION_TOKEN
env.description: Optional Replicator-specific source AWS session token for temporary credentials.

env.name: AWS_REPLICATOR_SOURCE_REGION_NAME
env.description: Optional Replicator-specific source AWS region. Use with the AWS_REPLICATOR_SOURCE_* credential group.

env.name: AWS_REPLICATOR_SOURCE_ENDPOINT_URL
env.description: Optional Replicator-specific source AWS endpoint URL for advanced source-account scenarios.

env.name: APP_INSPECTOR
env.description: Set to 1 in the LocalStack container environment to enable App Inspector by default across restarts. The MCP tool can also toggle App Inspector at runtime.
